body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News & Press Release> Sonoro introduced ‘cubo’, its German-designed and crafted CD/MP3 clock radio, to the US market at the CES 2008.
Expanding its distribution efforts, Sonoro welcomes home and office décor enthusiasts in North America to join the many European fans of cubo’s chic design and quality features.

cubo is built with a full-range speaker and integrated with a bass-reflex tube, providing music buffs a stylish solution for listening to their favorite songs in high-quality audio. The device comes equipped with a 3.5mm iPod / MP3 player connection, making music accessible from multiple sources. The product’s curved-corner design meshes easily with today’s contemporary or classic home and office atmosphere, coming in three sleek wood and seven-colored lacquer finishes.

cubo fits comfortably on nightstands, kitchen counters and tabletops, adding flair to any room. User-friendly buttons let individuals effortlessly control their music and program alarms to a desired song or radio station.

Sonoro’s entry into the US market provides the opportunity for US distributors to offer the cubo product line to specialty audio, high-end department stores and home décor and furnishing outlets, which attract cubo’s largest audience – both men and women with an eye for design. cubo will be available for purchase through select retailers in early 2008 with an MSRP of 289(USD).
